title: 第21章 灵稻成熟税赋上供第22章 小鬼难缠杏儿有喜
slug: 家族修仙我以子嗣登仙
content_zh:
松竹山下。
两道人影埋身于稻浪之中，将一簇簇灵稻连根砍下，然后再以青元果树的叶茎为绳捆紧。
其中一人是陈景安。
至于另外一人，则是被他抓来当壮丁的堂弟“陈景羽”
二伯让他教陈景羽灵雨术，陈景安想着种田之事贵在实践，于是给了堂弟一个劳动的机会。
他是真有在传授经验的，比如各种虫害的防治，以及可能出现的大小事项。
倘若把握不及，就会造成灵田的减产。
这对他们这种灵石来源极少的家族修士而言，无疑是致命的。
堂兄弟二人忙活了大半天，可算是将这两亩灵田给收完了，最终得到灵米一百七十三斤，灵米糠六十斤。
陈景安从中抽了三斤灵米，直接当场煮熟。
喷香的灵米，不用放任何的调料，这味道就已经胜过许多山珍海味了。
不过，比起黄府的宴席肯定是大有不如。
但人这种生物，其实是最忌讳好高骛远的。
尤其是肖想与自己身份不符的东西，就容易引来杀身之祸。
兄弟俩吃得津津有味。
陈景羽端着米饭，又看了看一旁堆成小垛的灵米，知道那全部是属于他九哥的私产，不由露出了羡慕之色。
“真羡慕九哥，这么多灵米都可以自己攒下来。”
陈景安最不喜欢被人羡慕，因为这样容易惹来红眼病，立即卖惨了起来。
说是卖惨，其实也是真惨。
至少，在他种田的前四年里，自己从灵田里赚到的，满打满算还凑不到一块灵石。

一切的变化。
始于自己从大儿子身上得到了“四灵根”
，再借着灵根中积累的力量突破到练气四层，连带着“灵雨术”
也一并突破，这才拥有了属于自己的灵田。
这各中的辛酸与忐忑，旁人是无法共情的。
再到后来他侥幸得到了“狼妖”
，背靠家族和六叔买到了“情根符”
，拥有了自己的养殖产业。
这也不是大风吹来的。
但凡自己不幸死于狼妖之手，或者六叔与他的关系不够好。
在任何一件上出了岔子。
这事都成不了。
陈景安回顾往昔，再想到自己即将进账四块灵石，也不由生出了一种成就感！
随后，他用乾坤袋将剩下的灵米装进去，又与陈景羽赶往另一块灵田。
content_en:
At the foot of Songzhu Mountain.
The two figures buried themselves in the rice waves, cutting down the clusters of spiritual rice by the roots, and then tied them tightly with the leaves and stems of the Qingyuan fruit tree.
One of them is Chen Jingan.
As for the other person, it was his cousin "Chen Jingyu" who was captured by him as a young man.
The second uncle asked him to teach Chen Jingyu the spirit rain technique. Chen Jing'an thought that farming is important in practice, so he gave his cousin a chance to work.
He is really imparting experience, such as the prevention and control of various pests, as well as major and minor matters that may arise.
If it is not grasped in time, it will cause the production of Lingtian to be reduced.
This is undoubtedly fatal to family monks like them who have very few sources of spiritual stones.
The two cousins ​​worked hard for a long time and finally harvested the two acres of spiritual land. Finally, they got 173 kilograms of spiritual rice and 60 kilograms of spiritual rice bran.
Chen Jingan took three kilograms of rice from it and cooked it on the spot.
The fragrant spirit rice, without any seasoning, already tastes better than many delicacies from the mountains and seas.
However, it is definitely not as good as the banquet in Huang Mansion.
But human beings are actually the most taboo about being too ambitious.
Especially if Xiao wants something that is inconsistent with his identity, it can easily lead to death.
The brothers ate with gusto.
Chen Jingyu was holding the rice and looked at the small piles of spiritual rice on the side. He knew that it was all the private property of his ninth brother, and he couldn't help but show envy.
"I really envy Ninth Brother, he can save so much spiritual rice by himself."
Chen Jingan didn't like to be envied by others, because it would easily cause pink eye, and he immediately became miserable.
It's said that it's a miserable sale, but it's actually really miserable.
At least, in the first four years of his farming, what he earned from the spiritual fields was less than a single spiritual stone.
Everything changes.
It started when I got the "four spiritual roots" from my eldest son.
, and then using the power accumulated in the spiritual roots to break through to the fourth level of Qi training, together with the "Spiritual Rain Technique"
He also broke through at the same time, and now he had his own spiritual field.
Others cannot sympathize with the bitterness and anxiety involved.
Later, he got the "Wolf Demon" by luck
, I bought the "Love Root Talisman" with the help of my family and my sixth uncle.
, has its own breeding industry.
This was not brought by the strong wind.
But unfortunately he died at the hands of the wolf demon, or the relationship between his sixth uncle and him was not good enough.
Anything goes wrong.
None of this will happen.
Chen Jingan looked back on the past and thought that he was about to receive four spiritual stones, and he couldn't help but feel a sense of accomplishment!
Afterwards, he put the remaining spiritual rice in the Qiankun bag, and rushed to another spiritual field with Chen Jingyu.
